errors.evidence: The dark-blue bar for "Erwartetes Geschäftsvolumen: gleichbleibend" (übrige Betriebe) reaches about 44%, not 60%.
The light-blue bar for "Erwartetes Geschäftsvolumen: fallend" is around 22%, not 5%.
The dark-blue bar for "Beschäftigungserwartung: gleichbleibend" is about 64%, not 55%.

The light-blue bar for "Beschäftigungserwartung: fallend" is about 10%, so this is only a rough estimate; the value is closer to 10 than stated, but the description omits that the dark-blue bar is nearer 6%.
The description omits that the bars are grouped by category and that the legend distinguishes the two series by color, although it does mention the colors and series names.
